summary: Added exported REPAIR_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000 and exported async repairResultFile() in src/goal/cli-worker.ts. The helper reads current result-file error kind, builds a repair prompt with complete/blocked/ralph/failed schema shapes, writes a real deny file via writeDenyFile(hardDenies, workerDir), invokes buildCliArgs() + runCliProcess() with a 60s timeout, logs to attempt-<N>.repair.stdout.txt/.stderr.txt, and re-reads worker_result.json via readWorkerResultFile({ primaryPath }) returning validated output or null. Verified with pnpm build, pnpm vitest run src/goal/cli-worker.test.ts, and pnpm lint.
